TASK real-004 (L8 Debugging): "Reproduce and fix the intermittent login timeout caused by a missing session refresh under concurrent requests" — DONE, all acceptance criteria verified.

**Bug reproduced (RED, before any edit):**
- Focused run `node --experimental-test-isolation=none --test test/session.test.js`: 3 pass / 1 fail — the regression test failed with `ERR_ASSERTION: second caller must await the in-flight refresh`.
- Baseline full suite: 32/35 pass (fails: session regression, plus 2 pre-existing seeded bugs for other tasks).

**Root cause (verified from code):** `src/session.js` (old line 35): `if (this.refreshing) return { ...session }` — a concurrent `refreshSession` call returned a synchronous snapshot of the session taken BEFORE the in-flight refresh completed. The caller then proceeded with an expiry that was never extended → intermittent login/auth timeouts. The doc comment in the fixture described exactly this bug.

**Fix (smallest change, committed as 1a75c34):** `src/session.js` — concurrent callers now await the SAME in-flight refresh promise: `this.refreshing` holds the running refresh promise; `if (this.refreshing) return this.refreshing`; `return await this.refreshing` inside try/finally (the `await` is required so `finally` clears the flag only after the refresh settles). All callers observe the freshly refreshed session. Also updated the stale BUG doc comment.

**Regression test:** existing fixture test "concurrent refreshes both complete with a fresh expiry (regression)" (red→green) + added "concurrent refreshes update the stored session (regression)" in `test/session.test.js`.

- Session tests: 5/5 pass, exit 0.
